scenario: Fictional Campus Mobility pilot / controlled station departure
environment: fenced test course, dry surface, supervised demonstrations
intended_use: teaching example for traceability and release review, not operational approval

hazards.description: Door release while the vehicle is moving

requirements.statement: An open-door authorization shall be inhibited unless measured speed is at most 0.5 m/s and the parking brake is engaged.
Dispatch shall acknowledge an accepted supervised pilot request within 2.0 s under the stated test load.

controls.assumption: Brake and speed inputs represent independent, fresh, plausible measurements
Test load and network conditions bound the intended pilot use

evidence.limitations: Only injected cases; no common-cause fault demonstration
Does not establish a tail reliability rate or behavior at field load

fault_tree.meaning: Simplified event probabilities per one door-open demand; all basic events treated as independent

open_questions: Common cause p=0.003 is assumed, not measured
Sensor freshness not yet independently validated
Operational environment is broader than test envelope
